observations: Initial occupied slots two-three-four and seven gave slot five four of ten possible hash starts and slot eight two of ten.
First inserted key hashed seven and moved to eight with two probes.

Filling table included wraparound to zero and one; last insertion took six probes. Reveal recalls initial probabilities and observed growth as primary clustering.
